scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,blue "npm run dev -w @networking-tracker/api" "npm run dev -w @networking-tracker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @networking-tracker/api && npm run build -w @networking-tracker/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @networking-tracker/api && npm run lint -w @networking-tracker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @networking-tracker/api && npm run typecheck -w @networking-tracker/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @networking-tracker/api && npm run test -w @networking-tracker/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @networking-tracker/api && npm run test:coverage -w @networking-tracker/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
